name: ai-ugc-ad-video
description: Open-source alternative to Arcads: AI UGC ads with an AI actor holding your real product. Casts a creator whose age matches the claim in the room where the problem happens, writes a phone-real script (a yapper, unboxing, street interview or in-car take) with every line in the prompt, locks the face, the voice and the product label across shots, prompts camera flaws and breaths so it doesn't look waxy, generates on Seedance 2.5, Kling 4 or Creatify through varg, and labels it. It never puts a first-person testimonial or result in an AI mouth (FTC rule) and never targets TikTok Shop presenters (AI voices banned there). Use when someone wants AI UGC ads, an AI creator or actor talking about their product, Arcads/Creatify/MakeUGC-style ads, or UGC without hiring creators. NOT for TikTok Shop affiliate videos (use tiktok-shop-video), product-only shots with no person (use product-photo-to-video), or the same characters across a multi-scene story (use varg-consistent-characters).
